_week: 2026-11-02 to 2026-11-08 (Week 45). Written from this week's numbers.
week_story: Revenue rose 4.0% to $47,877 while ad spend fell 20.8% to $5,366, so TACoS dropped from 14.7% to 11.2%.
The All-Natural cleaning solutions led the gain: 16oz +39% and 8oz +31%. Refresh Kit fell 15%; the top three products moved less than 3%.
refunds: Refunds were $899 this week (2.25% refund rate), up from $628 (1.56%) the week before. Still a low rate; no action needed.
pacing_reco: November is 9.7% behind last year to date ($55,717 vs $61,707). Essential Kit has about 2.3 weeks available at FBA, so getting its 552 inbound units checked in before Black Friday matters most.
ads_context: Spend fell 21% but ad sales only slipped 3% to $17,401, so ACoS improved from 37.6% to 30.8%.
Sponsored Brands spend was cut 41% to $1,484; Sponsored Products held at $2,797 (31.0% ACoS).
ads_strategy: Branded keywords returned $9,102 on $1,354 (14.9% ACoS) and brought 266 orders.
Category keywords cost $3,237 for $6,496 in sales (49.8% ACoS); that spend was down 33% on last week.
bid_moves: Lower bids on the Sponsored Brands “shoe cleaning” phrase target: $436 spent at 54.7% ACoS.
Lower or pause “shoe cleaning kit” (SB video, phrase): $98 for $55 in sales.
Competitor targeting spend more than doubled to $317 for $302 in sales; trim “jason markk” (71.5% ACoS).
promotions: This week: 342 promotion orders and $1,138 in promotional discounts (vs 339 orders and $927 last week).
